title: US officials seek ‘final end’ to Russia-Ukraine war as Abu Dhabi talks begin
summary_full: First substantive peace talks since February to include US proposal for ‘long-term security architecture’ between Moscow and EuropeEurope live – latest updatesUS officials have said they are seeking a “final end” to the war between Russia and Ukraine, beginning with trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, the first substantive negotiations between the two countries since February.The talks are the first since the US launched joint strikes with Israel against Iran, and they follow bruising midterm elections that have weakened Donald Trump at home. The first day of talks ended early Tuesday afternoon local time with a second day set for Wednesday. Continue reading...
